question: Which of the following kings was sent by Aurangzeb against Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jai Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jai Singh** was a Rajput ruler who was sent by the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb to subdue Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
 
• He played a significant role in the Mughal campaigns against the Marathas.
 
• Jai Singh led a large army and successfully captured several Maratha forts, compelling Shivaji to sign the Treaty of Purandar in 1665.
 
• This treaty resulted in Shivaji ceding 23 forts and territory to the Mughals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Aurangzeb was the sixth Mughal emperor, ruling from 1658 to 1707, and is known for his expansionist policies.
 
• Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj was the founder of the Maratha Empire in western India and is known for his guerrilla warfare tactics and administrative reforms.
 
• The conflict between the Mughals and the Marathas was part of a larger struggle for control over the Indian subcontinent during the 17th century.
 
• The Treaty of Purandar marked a temporary setback for Shivaji, but he later recaptured most of the lost territories.
